title: Add Men's Fashion Pins to image
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Men's Fashion Pins](https://fashionpins4u.blogspot.com/p/mens-fashion-pins.html) to image
- Create attractive images of men's fashion for pinterest using pollinations. this app is using gpt-image-2 model.

Fixes #14676

gist.headline: Pins, petals, and pocket squares
gist.blurb: A new little fashion studio has landed in the garden. It uses gpt-image-2 to turn men's style ideas into Pinterest-ready images, because apparently the hive has opinions about tailoring now.
gist.summary: Added Men's Fashion Pins, a community app that uses the gpt-image-2 model to create attractive Pinterest images for men's fashion.
gist.impact: People can now use a dedicated Pollinations-powered app to quickly generate polished men's-fashion pin artwork for Pinterest.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy pixel-art fashion moodboard: a retro monitor displays a neat men's outfit pin with a blazer, shoes, and pocket square, while little pinned image cards grow among flowers. Polli, wearing a tiny tailor's beret and measuring tape, arranges the pins; the scene represents a community-built Pinterest image generator.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art fashion studio with a retro CRT monitor showing a Pinterest-style men's outfit moodboard of a blazer, shoes, and pocket square, surrounded by flower pots and code-plants sprouting tiny image pins in prominent lime green (#ecf874). The main character is a cute pixel art bee mascot with a yellow body and dark brown horizontal stripes, small black legs, two black antennae, black vertical oval eyes, bright pink rectangular blush marks on cheeks, a small happy smile, and small rounded light blue translucent wings; she wears a tiny tailor's beret and measuring tape while carefully pinning fashion cards beside the screen. Cozy 8-bit pixel art aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, dark purple (#110518) outlines, nostalgic but beautiful and emotionally warm.
